Statutory timetable

Date Action
12 October 2026 Consultation on proposed undertakings in lieu of reference
29 September 2026 CMA to consider undertakings offered
15 September 2026 Phase 1 decision announced
30 July 2026 Launch of merger inquiry
23 July 2026 Initial enforcement order
4 June 2026 Invitation to comment

Phase 1

Consultation: undertakings in lieu of reference

12 October 2026: The CMA is consulting on proposed undertakings in lieu of a reference to a phase 2 investigation offered by Co-operative Group Limited in relation to its completed acquisition of The Southern Co-operative Limited.

  • Notice of consultation of undertakings in lieu (PDF, 198KB) (12.10.26)
  • Proposed undertakings (PDF 198KB) (12.10.26)

CMA to consider undertakings offered

29 September 2026: The CMA considers that there are reasonable grounds for believing that the undertakings offered by Co-operative Group Limited, or a modified version of them, might be accepted by the CMA under the Enterprise Act 2002.

  • Full text decision (PDF, 206KB) (7.10.26)
  • Press release: CMA proposes to accept remedies in Co-op Group deal to address competition concerns (29.9.26)

Reference unless undertakings accepted

15 September 2026: The CMA has decided, on the evidence currently available to it, that it is or may be the case that this merger has resulted or may be expected to result in a substantial lessening of competition within a market or markets in the United Kingdom. This merger will be referred for an in-depth, phase 2 investigation unless the parties offer an acceptable undertaking to address these competition concerns.

  • Full text decision (PDF, 346KB) (7.10.26)
  • Summary of phase 1 decision (PDF, 103KB) (15.9.26)

Launch of merger inquiry

30 July 2026: The CMA announced the launch of its merger inquiry by notice to the parties.

  • Commencement notice (PDF, 89KB) (30.7.26)

Initial enforcement order

23 July 2026: The CMA has served an initial enforcement order (IEO) under section 72(2) of the Enterprise Act 2002 on Co-operative Group Limited and Siena Co-operative Limited.

  • Initial enforcement order (PDF, 197KB) (23.7.26)

Amendments and consents granted

  • Derogation 29 July 2026 (1) (PDF, 198KB) (30.7.26)
  • Derogation 29 July 2026 (2) (PDF, 184KB) (30.7.26)
  • Derogation 30 July 2026 (PDF, 174KB) (30.7.26)
  • Derogation 13 August 2026 (PDF, 176KB) (19.8.26)
  • Derogation 17 August 2026 (PDF, 176KB) (19.8.26)
  • Derogation 26 August 2026 (1) (PDF, 196KB) (2.9.26)
  • Derogation 26 August 2026 (2) (PDF, 176KB) (2.9.26)
  • Derogation 3 September 2026 (PDF, 197KB) (15.9.26)
  • Derogation 23 September 2026 (PDF, 174KB) (29.9.26)
  • Derogation 6 October 2026 (PDF, 176KB) (12.10.26)
  • Derogation 8 October 2026 (PDF, 178KB) (12.10.26)

Invitation to comment

4 June 2026: The CMA issued this ‘invitation to comment’ to allow interested parties to submit to the CMA any initial views on the impact that the transaction could have on competition in the UK. The CMA has not yet launched its formal investigation into this transaction. The invitation to comment is the first part of the CMA’s information-gathering process.

To assist it with this assessment, the CMA invites comments on the transaction from any interested party.

Pre-notification

4 June 2026: The CMA has received the necessary information from the parties to commence pre-notification.

Contact

Please send written representations about any competition issues to:

  • coopgroup.southerncoop@cma.gov.uk
  • Jeremy Chan, Principal Case Officer, jeremy.chan@cma.gov.uk, 020 3738 6784

Privacy notice

Your name and contact details are your personal data. In collecting, receiving, storing, accessing and using your personal data, the CMA, as controller, is processing your personal data. The CMA processes personal data in accordance with data protection law. The CMA is processing your personal data so that it can contact you again, should it need further help or information from you, in order to carry out its merger work under Part 3 of the Enterprise Act 2002. For more information about how the CMA processes personal data and your rights relating to that data, please read our personal information charter.
